indication_area: Oncology (BRAF V600 mutation-positive melanoma, NSCLC and other solid tumours)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 202806 NDA APPROVAL ... for Tafinlar (dabrafenib) capsules, 50 mg and 75 mg

launch_evidence.quote: Tafinlar and Mekinist, which were both launched in Q2 2013 as monotherapy treatments

series_start_reason: 2013Q3 is the first quarter whose own GSK results announcement prints a Tafinlar turnover row as current; the Q2 2013 announcement (0001191638-13-000943) lists the US approval but prints no Tafinlar sales figure, so Q2 2013 is left out rather than derived.
series_end_reason: GSK's oncology portfolio passed to Novartis in 2015. From the Q1 2015 report onward the brand is reported by Novartis only inside the combined line 'Tafinlar + Mekinist' (first printed as 'Mekinist/Tafinlar' 40 for Q1 2015, 0001370368-15-000043), which adds the two brands together and is a different scope, so it is not spliced onto this single-brand GSK series.
notes: GSK Group worldwide turnover of Tafinlar in GBP millions; the only issuer that printed Tafinlar on its own line. Check: 2014 = 22+33+37+43 = 135 equals the 2014 figure printed in the Q4 2014 announcement (135); 2013 Q3+Q4 = 4+11 = 15 against FY 2013 16 printed in the Q4 2013 announcement (the difference of 1 is Q2 2013, not printed in its own announcement). Novartis (owner since 2015) prints one combined 'Tafinlar + Mekinist' line (footnote: 'Majority of sales for Mekinist and Tafinlar are combination, but both can be used as monotherapy') through 2026Q2 (581 for Q2 2026 in 0001114448-26-000012); that combined line is not this brand's own sales and is not used. US launch was Q2 2013; GSK states European launch of Tafinlar in Q3 2013. First-approval-year evidence is the FDA NDA approval letter.
search_log: Novartis EX-99.2 interim reports 2012Q2-2026Q2 (CIK 1114448) scanned by script for rows labelled Tafinlar or Mekinist: only the combined 'Tafinlar/Mekinist' / 'Tafinlar + Mekinist' row exists (Q1 2015 onward); no single-brand Novartis row, no Odomzo-style separate listing.
Novartis 20-F annual reports FY2014-FY2017 searched for single-brand Tafinlar or Mekinist sales: only 'Tafinlar/Mekinist' combined from FY2015.

Rung d (prior owner): GSK (CIK 1131399) 6-K filings 2013-04 to 2015-06 indexed via data.sec.gov submissions (all 6-K forms); the quarterly results announcements (0001191638-13-000943 Q2 2013, -13-001342 Q3 2013, -14-000145 Q4 2013, -14-000647 Q1 2014, -14-001050 Q2 2014, -14-001364 Q3 2014, -15-000135 Q4 2014) were downloaded and each Tafinlar/Mekinist row read from the HTML table.
Q2 2013 announcement prints no Tafinlar or Mekinist figure; Q3 2013 announcement prints Tafinlar 4 and Mekinist 3 with nine months 5 and 3.
